behavioral.scope: Address/masked-write behavioral candidate only; no transistor timing,125MHz,collision or SoC compatibility acceptance. Original model remains unchanged.

vendor_update_comparison.scope: Only this256x16macro officialGDSupdate compared with pinnedc4b8; not a fresh LVS measurement.
vendor_update_comparison.conclusion: No transistor, interconnect, bitcell resistor or supply geometry change. This update does not resolve the already measured interior mismatches; no PDK replacement/adoption.

limitations: The upstream model writes the previous registered address. A separate four-index corrected copy passes1540 behavioral checks on both ports and byte masks; this is not transistor/model equivalence.
A nominal two-clock90ns transistor simulation is active separately; no completed dual-port transistor acceptance is claimed or mutable waveform archived.

No same-address collision qualification, complete patterns/PVT,125MHz operation, extracted-RC characterization, setup/hold/Liberty, LEF/routing access, bit-mask/MEN/BIST equivalence, SoC adoption or reliability/radiation acceptance.
Existing SoC vendor SRAM interiorLVS, actual routed setup/hold/slew/capacitance and filled-chip signoff remain open.
